title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the briefing says Learn does not identify any part of the node as still in preview, but the updated node page explicitly identifies workflow-agent success criteria as preview. claims.claim: The agent node hands a workflow step to an AI agent for reasoning.
claims.quote: The agent node lets a flow hand a step over to an AI agent that can reason, call tools, and pull from knowledge sources before returning a result.

claims.claim: The agent in a node can call attached tools.
claims.quote: Equip the agent with tools (Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and connectors) so it can take action.

claims.claim: The agent in a node can read attached knowledge sources.
claims.quote: Ground the agent in knowledge (SharePoint sites, public websites) so it can answer from your content.

claims.claim: The agent response becomes dynamic content for subsequent workflow steps.
claims.quote: The agent response then becomes available as dynamic content that you can use in any subsequent step.
